ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by a dominant low-intensity (black) central and basal region (approx. 65% of surface area) transitioning to high-intensity (white/light-grey) mottling on the distal lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity pixels form a solid contiguous mass from the peduncle through the central fluke. High-intensity pixels form irregular, speckled mottling on the lateral thirds of both lobes. Several discrete, circular low-intensity focal spots (diameter 5-15 pixels) are embedded within the high-intensity regions of the lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped indentation with an estimated interior angle of 40-45 degrees; notch depth extends approximately 12% of the total vertical height of the fluke assembly.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge. Distinct peaks and valleys (amplitude 3-8 pixels) create a jagged linear boundary, with more pronounced irregular notches observed on the inner margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins exhibit a strong convex curvature, sweeping upward and outward to terminate in acute, pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular, high-contrast dark spots on white backgrounds located on the distal tips. Presence of 3D-textured, high-intensity pixel clusters at the extreme lateral tips consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel high-intensity (white) linear streaks visible on the dark pixel field of the left central lobe, oriented approximately 30 degrees from the horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations on the distal-most tips of both lobes; multiple irregular concave notches on the trailing edge likely indicating historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Overlay of high-intensity specular reflections (water droplets) across the central low-intensity region, creating a secondary noise pattern over the pigment data.
